name: Wrecking Blows
body:
Your violent swings shatter armor and shields.

Prerequisite(s): Power Attack, Base Attack Bonus +3.

Benefit: Whenever you miss an opponent benefiting from worn armor or a carried shield with a weapon attack by 5 or less, reduce the armor or shield bonus (your choice) by 1 as you glance against the foe’s defenses. These reductions last until the bearer takes a move action to readjust their armor or shield. This effect stacks and if a suit of armor has its armor bonus reduced by more than half its total that piece of armor gains the broken condition and must be repaired. Though since it has not lost HP this requires only a craft check of the appropriate DC for the armor and 1 hour of work.
